description: This file is a BitBake include (.inc) file used for configuring build dependencies and deployment steps for a Xen-based virtualization image tailored for Xilinx hardware. It specifies dependencies, kernel load addresses, and a deployment task for creating a U-Boot image with Xen support.

methods.name: do_deploy
methods.description: A function appended to handle deployment, creating a Xen image using uboot-mkimage if the specified file exists.
